text.6:2: He it is Who hath created you from clay, and hath decreed a term for you. A term is fixed with Him. Yet still ye doubt!
text.15:63: They said: Nay, but we bring thee that concerning which they keep disputing,
text.19:34: Such was Jesus, son of Mary: (this is) a statement of the truth concerning which they doubt.
text.43:61: And lo! verily there is knowledge of the Hour. So doubt ye not concerning it, but follow Me. This is the right path.
text.44:50: Lo! this is that whereof ye used to doubt.
